title: Data for normalized raw rational finite restriction descent
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y,s$, and arrows $f:X\to Y$ and $y:s\to Y$. For an integral comparison diagram $I$ [def-zl-finite-restriction-integral-diagram], define RationalComparisons to consist of three morphisms between the prescribed coefficient stage systems, two compatible Hom records for exchange and restriction, and the literal object, pure-tensor map, component, and scalar-comparison normalization equalities. Define its descended transformations by StageSystem.Morphism.descNatTrans. For a finite-field datum D and ell different from its characteristic, SectionsCompatible means integral naturality of the prescribed inverse sections-tensor/completion comparison and naturality of the prescribed rational fibre scalar comparison. For geometry G [def-zl-finite-restriction-geometric-comparisons], DirectImageDescent means existence of a stage-system morphism with exactly G.rationalImage.rational as its stage functors and the inverse theta comparisons as beta, together with TExactDescent and HeartExactDescent [def-zl-finite-restriction-finite-data]. These definitions are moved verbatim from the coefficient-descent module; no object or map is redefined.
